# spyro up

Start tunnels for a profile (or every profile with forwarded_ports).

## Before you run it

Starts tunnels for the given profile (or EVERY profile with `forwarded_ports` when omitted). Always pass the profile.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro up`

```text
Usage: spyro up [OPTIONS] [PROFILE]

  Start tunnels for a profile (or every profile with forwarded_ports).

Options:
  --no-daemon  Run in the foreground (Ctrl+C stops it)
  --help       Show this message and exit.
```
